resources.string: Wi-Fi Direct · Dev server (root)

Requires root and Android Auto developer setup. On the head unit select Wireless Helper → Wi-Fi Direct; no special head-unit build or Dev-server checkbox is needed. The helper bridges the local Dev server to the head unit and manages the server, including one started manually. Reconnect is automatic, even after Exit on the head unit. Stop in the helper or 5 seconds without the selected Bluetooth devices shuts it down.

Android Auto 17.4+ blocks the legacy Wireless Helper trigger. On a rooted phone use Wi-Fi Direct · Dev server (root), with Wireless Helper → Wi-Fi Direct on the head unit. The helper bridges the Dev server to the ordinary Helper connection. Without root, use a manually started server with Headunit Server mode, or a supported Native connection.
